latest_release.body:
### Breaking

- Require React 19.3+  7829102
- `minWidth` and `maxWidth` on `<Box>` now only accept numbers ([#1029](https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink/issues/1029))  7cd7fd9
  - Percentage strings were never documented as supported, and Yoga resolved them against the wrong ancestor
- `stdin`, `stdout`, and `stderr` are now typed as generic Node.js streams ([#981](https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink/issues/981))  eb82d8f
  - This applies to the `render()` options and to `useStdin()`, `useStdout()`, and `useStderr()`. TTY-only properties like `stdout.columns` are no longer part of the types
- `useInput` no longer receives unrecognized terminal control sequences (#1014)  c76893e
  - Mouse reports, focus in/out events, cursor position reports, and other terminal replies used to arrive in `input` with the ESC stripped, as if typed. They are now dropped

### New

- Add [`contentOffsetX`](https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink#contentoffsetx) and [`contentOffsetY`](https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink#contentoffsety) props to `<Box>` for building scrollable views ([#765](https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink/issues/765))  3ba5828
  - Combine with `overflow="hidden"`. See the [scroll example](https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink/tree/master/examples/scroll)
- Add [`clientWidth`](https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink#clientwidth) and [`clientHeight`](https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink#clientheight) to `useBoxMetrics()` and [`measureElement()`](https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink#measureelementref) (#988)  3ba5828
  - The element size excluding borders, which is the space its content can occupy
- Accept any Node.js stream for the `stdin`, `stdout`, and `stderr` options of `render()` ([#981](https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink/issues/981))  eb82d8f
  - For example, `PassThrough` or other `Readable`/`Writable` streams. Raw mode is used only when `stdin` is a TTY with `setRawMode()`
- Skip unchanged line prefixes in [`incrementalRendering`](https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink#incrementalrendering) mode (#1036)  91eb50a
  - Only the changed part of a line is written, which reduces output and flicker
- Drop the `ws` dependency in favor of the native `WebSocket` for React DevTools ([#976](https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink/issues/976))  33567ed
- Recognize application keypad Enter as `key.return`  b73ebf4

### Fixes

#### Rendering

- Preserve scrollback when clearing the viewport (#994)  fe1d123
- Preserve terminal history after `clear()`  494ebeb
- Restore the unchanged frame when rerendering after `clear()`  fc358c2
- Redraw the frame when the terminal loses rows (#1025)  f603aeb
- Keep content above the frame when rows shrink while the cursor is shown (#1031)  c800284
- Keep the cursor on the last line when output has no trailing newline (#982)  cdc18fa
- Restore the terminal cursor below the frame on exit  06385e9
- Preserve the cursor position when its component skips rendering  013feb2
- Fix incremental rendering of single-line updates, new blank rows, and changed rows (#1039)  9a501e4 507c0c9 509ea75
- Fix overflow clipping when both the shorthand and an explicit axis are set, and preserve `<Transform>` line indices when clipping  4f3c7aa
- Fix background color inheritance for `<Static>` and nested `<Text>`  753a5f8
- Fix fractional percentages being truncated in layout sizes, and restore layout defaults when style props are `undefined`  274b15a
- Preserve visibility across Suspense transitions  fc685bc
- Call `onRender` after the frame is written  83d7de5

#### `<Static>`

- Stop replaying `<Static>` output on full-clear frames (#1005)  d661543
- Replay `<Static>` output when resuming re-enters the alternate screen (#1012)  9235028
- Fix repeated padding, ignored margins, and output inside hidden ancestors  793fe59
- Keep `<Static>` output after abandoned concurrent renders  8678b76
- Reset captured `<Static>` output when its identity changes  cfdd9e6
- Preserve blank `<Static>` rows  f6b26
